description: This file defines a helper class 'OA_Admin_Statistics_Daily' for generating daily statistics in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for parsing date parameters and displaying context links for daily statistics.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Statistics_Daily
classes.description: Helper class for generating daily statistics, including parsing date parameters and showing context links.

methods.name: parseDay
methods.description: Parses a 'day' parameter, validates it, and stores the date range in an array.

methods.name: showContext
methods.description: Prepares and displays context links for daily statistics based on provided dates and current selection.
